rationale: meta-harness (Wave MH-4, build plan section 3, self-application) is the meta-harness layer's own family, so its list is declared here too, and it is the one entry that is self-referential twice over: both F28-harness-run-integrity.mjs (F28's own rules) and governing-files.mjs (what defines every family's governing files, meta-harness's own included) are named in meta-harness's own list. A future edit to either file moves the meta-harness family's own harness_version exactly like editing validate-mint-payload.mjs moves mint's, the literal mechanism by which the loop applies to itself (plan section 1) is enforced, not just narrated.
